current_formulation: Annotators label reply links between chat messages, and each connected component of the reply graph is one conversation.

steps.formulation: Disentanglement clusters the utterances of one transcript into separate conversations.
steps.quote: Disentanglement is the clustering task of dividing a transcript into a set of distinct conversations.

criticism.quote: datasets that are either small (2,500 messages, Elsner and Charniak, 2008) or not released (Adams and Martell, 2008).

steps.formulation: Messages are nodes of a reply graph, and each connected component is a conversation.
steps.quote: We label this data with a graph in which messages are nodes and edges indicate that one message is a response to another.

criticism.quote: risks introducing a bias, as people write differently when explicit structure is defined
